healthcare-value-chain.note: Figure 1. Connections show functional categories, not verified supply contracts, customers or ownership. Company examples are non-exhaustive and unranked. healthcare-us-expenditure-2024.title: Where US healthcare expenditure goes
healthcare-us-expenditure-2024.scope: National Health Expenditure Accounts: US$5,278.6 billion in 2024, including investment. This is expenditure composition, not supplier market share.

source.publisher: US Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services
source.title: [E05] National Health Expenditure Accounts Table 2 and NHE Fact Sheet
source.published: Fact sheet last modified 2026-06-24; table is the 1960 to 2024 historical release
source.locator: Table 2 Amount in Billions 2024 column rows 4 7 9 and 16; Fact Sheet Historical NHE 2024

healthcare-us-expenditure-2024.note: Figure 2. Slice areas use the published expenditure amounts converted from US$ billion to US$ million; labels are rounded to one decimal. Remaining NHE = 5,278.6 − 1,634.7 − 1,109.7 − 467.0 = US$2,067.2 billion, including other care, administration, public health and investment. Retail drugs exclude medicines recorded within service expenditure. Source E05.

healthcare-us-medicare-advantage-mar-202.title: Medicare Advantage enrollment shares
healthcare-us-medicare-advantage-mar-202.scope: US Medicare Advantage enrollment by parent organization, excluding Original Medicare. This is one insurance submarket, not all US insurance or global healthcare.

source.title: [E07] Medicare Advantage in 2026: Enrollment Update and Key Trends
source.locator: Section on enrollment concentration Figure 6 and its methods note

healthcare-us-medicare-advantage-mar-202.note: Figure 3. Published rounded KFF shares based on CMS enrollment files. Remaining organizations = 100 − 26 − 20 − 12 − 6 − 5 = 31%; this residual inherits source rounding and is not an independently measured exact share. DEX did not reaggregate CMS enrollment microdata. Shares do not measure revenue or clinical quality. Source E07.

healthcare-china-hospital-visits-2025.title: China hospital visits by ownership
healthcare-china-hospital-visits-2025.metric: Share of hospital diagnosis and treatment visits (%)
healthcare-china-hospital-visits-2025.scope: Public and private hospitals in China; denominator 4.67 billion hospital visits in 2025. This is hospital activity, not revenue, profit or care-quality share.

source.publisher: National Health Commission of China; official PDF hosted by Shanxi Health Commission
source.title: [E06] 2025年我国卫生健康事业发展统计公报 China Health Statistics Bulletin 2025
source.published: NHC release dated 2026-08-28; provincial PDF hosted August 2026
source.locator: Printed page 1 hospital counts; page 6 Table 4; pages 7 to 8 hospital diagnosis and treatment visits and Table 5

healthcare-china-hospital-visits-2025.note: Figure 4. Calculated from published rounded totals: public 39.3 and private 7.4, divided by 46.7, in units of 100 million hospital visits. Values are converted to millions for the table and slice areas; percentages are rounded to one decimal. Visits count encounters, not unique patients. Private hospitals account for 69.4% of facilities and 15.8% of visits; these describe different measures. Source E06.
